vulnerabilities.name: Secrets Management via Environment Variables
vulnerabilities.description: All secrets are now retrieved from environment variables only
vulnerabilities.verification: No hardcoded credentials found in code

vulnerabilities.name: Input Sanitization and Output Encoding
vulnerabilities.description: All user inputs are sanitized using MarkupSafe.escape()
vulnerabilities.implementation: sanitize_input() function applied to all endpoints
vulnerabilities.verification: XSS payloads are rendered as escaped text, not executed

vulnerabilities.name: Content Security Policy Headers
vulnerabilities.description: CSP headers restrict script execution to same-origin only
vulnerabilities.verification: CSP headers present in all responses

vulnerabilities.name: Secure Session Management
vulnerabilities.description: Sessions use httpOnly, Secure, and SameSite flags
vulnerabilities.implementation: Flask session config with secure cookie settings
vulnerabilities.verification: Session cookies are httpOnly and Secure

vulnerabilities.name: Debug Endpoints Removed
vulnerabilities.description: All debug and source code endpoints have been removed

vulnerabilities.name: Secure Error Handling
vulnerabilities.description: Error responses return generic messages without details
vulnerabilities.implementation: Generic error handlers without stack traces
vulnerabilities.verification: Stack traces not exposed in error responses

vulnerabilities.name: No Secrets in API Responses
vulnerabilities.description: API endpoints return only necessary user data
vulnerabilities.implementation: API responses filtered to exclude credentials
vulnerabilities.verification: No API keys, passwords, or internal URLs in responses

vulnerabilities.name: Secure Logging
vulnerabilities.description: Logging configured to exclude sensitive data
vulnerabilities.implementation: No console.log() of credentials; server-side logging only
vulnerabilities.verification: Browser console clean; no credentials logged
